FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns rushing to and fro. But amidst the chaos, a peculiar sight catches the eye: the king, resplendent in his ornate armor, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING (he/him) addresses his court, his voice booming through the halls.

KING
(to his advisors, they, him)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our great empire. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1 (she/her) raises an eyebrow.

ADVISOR 1
(she/her)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING
(nodding, he)
Yes, futurism. We shall incorporate the latest trends from the East, the mystique of the Orient. (he gestures, he) Behold!

The camera zooms in on the king's throne, where a sleek, silver laptop sits atop a velvet cushion. The king's advisors stare in confusion.

ADVISOR 2 (he/him) whispers to Advisor 1.

ADVISOR 2
(he/him)
What sorcery is this?

ADVISOR 1
(she/her)
I think it's some sort of... (she glances at the laptop)...magic box.

KING
(smiling, he)
Ah, no magic box, my friends. This is the future. (he types away on the laptop, he) Behold, the wonders of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...vaporwave.

The camera cuts to a montage of the kingdom's aesthetic transforming before our eyes. The stone walls are now adorned with neon-lit, pixelated patterns. The knights' armor is replaced with sleek, futuristic jumpsuits. The ladies' gowns are now flowing, pastel-colored dresses with built-in, flashing LED lights.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who look on in confusion.

KING
(to his advisors, they)
We shall call this new era... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...Vaporia.

ADVISOR 3 (she/her) speaks up.

ADVISOR 3
(she/her)
But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional values?

KING
(waving his hand, he)
Pfft, traditional values are so... (he shrugs, he) passé. We shall forge a new path, one of innovation and... (he smiles, he)...futurism.

The camera zooms out as the advisors look on, unsure of what to make of the king's new vision.

CUT TO:

EXT. VAPORIA - DAY

The kingdom is now a futuristic, neon-lit wonderland. Knights in jumpsuits ride hoverbikes, while ladies in pastel-colored dresses float through the air on cloud-like contraptions. The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who look on in awe.

KING
(to his advisors, they)
Welcome to Vaporia, my friends. A new era of... (he smiles, he)...futurism.

FADE TO BLACK.
